derived_from.rule: Only development/source evidence may influence A1. BENCH-004 must not be used to tune this profile.

scope: cognitive orchestration meta-parameters only; not neural model weights
promotion_gate: A1 is not promoted unless BENCH-004 on unseen families and unseen seeds shows matched-resource heldout improvement vs A0, no material family regression, leakage audit pass, and reproducible rerun.
claim_limit: A1 is a frozen experimental configuration, not neural-weight learning and not evidence of self-improvement until prospectively validated.
